headline: Manba Finance releases its latest investor presentation to the exchange

headline: Manba Finance announces November 6 as dividend record date

Shareholders holding the stock as of this date will be eligible for the dividend. For retail investors, this confirms the timeline for the scheduled cash distribution from the company.

This distribution provides a direct cash return to shareholders of the company. Indian retail investors holding the stock as of the record date will receive the payout. The announcement offers a routine income update for current holders of the company's shares.

why_it_matters: Shareholders receive a minor cash payout per share.

headline: Manba Finance allots 60,000 non-convertible debt securities
hook: Fresh debt allotment at Manba Finance
summary: Manba Finance Limited has approved the allotment of 60,000 non-convertible securities during a board meeting on October 12. The issue allows the non-banking financial company to raise debt capital for its lending business without diluting equity share capital. For retail equity shareholders, such debt issuances are standard treasury operations that add leverage but do not affect voting rights or ownership percentages.
why_it_matters: Routine debt funding brings in capital with zero equity dilution.
